name: Bishoujo Shashinkan - Moving School
original_name: 美少女写真館 ムービング・スクール
source:
In this game your task is to photograph pretty girls in various situations. You are given a choice of point-and-shoot, single lens reflex and a pro camera. In order to get a real photograph, you must evaluate the lighting situation and subject and choose the correct shutter speed, film speed, aperture and whether to use flash or not.

The choice of camera is also a choice of difficulty level. With a point-and-shoot, you need only get one variable right, whereas the pro camera requires you to set both aperture, shutter and film speed correctly.

You are only given a few chances per shoot to get the right exposure, or you will just see a miscoloured picture flash briefly. Judging the exposure correctly grants you a picture of the girl, often in a surprising state of undressing, whereafter you progress to even more erotic poses. Later stages raise the difficulty level, forcing you to use the SLR, and later the meter-less pro camera.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/63952/]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你的任务是在各种情境下为美少女拍摄写真。你可以从傻瓜相机、单反相机与专业相机中进行选择。要想拍出一张真正合格的照片，你必须准确判断现场光线条件与拍摄对象的状态，设置恰当的快门速度、胶片感光度、光圈大小，并决定是否开启闪光灯。

相机的选择同时也对应着不同的难度等级：使用傻瓜相机只需调准一项参数即可，而使用专业相机则必须同时正确设置光圈、快门与胶片感光度。

每次拍摄你只有寥寥几次抓准曝光的机会，否则屏幕上只会一闪而过一张色彩失真的废片。成功找准曝光后，你便能收获一张少女的写真——画面中的她往往正处于令人惊喜的宽衣解带状态，随后更会解锁愈发大胆撩人的姿势。后期关卡难度将逐步提升，强制你使用单反相机，乃至没有测光表的专业相机进行拍摄。
